name: Coffee Cupping Report
purpose: Ranks coffee lots by cupping score for each country and harvest year

inputs.origin_country: Country the coffee beans were grown in
inputs.farm_name: Name of the farm that grew the coffee
inputs.harvest_year: Year or season the coffee was harvested
inputs.grading_date: Date the coffee was graded by the cupping panel
inputs.aroma_score: Score given for the coffee's smell, out of 10
inputs.min_altitude_m: Lowest altitude the coffee was grown at, in meters
inputs.bag_count: Number of bags in the lot
inputs.roast_level: How dark the beans were roasted, such as light, medium or dark
inputs.price_per_kg: Price paid for one kilogram of the coffee
